blurb: Capital Flows (@Globalflows) is a self-identified Christian macro analyst who maps the macroeconomic regime across rates, FX, and equities to identify high-conviction trades. They post daily macro analysis, free reports, and educational threads covering topics like S&P 500 sector performance, factor analysis, and cross-asset correlations. They host a live weekday stream at 8:30am MST and share free daily reports with followers.
